purpose: PR #426: preserve refreshed default tokens and bound concurrent account reads

scope.http: Non-OPTIONS requests without an explicit LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN
scope.scheduler: Existing cron/DO tick; no trigger or interval changes

queryModel.http: One getLineAccounts SELECT per DB-binding/default-secret cache miss; concurrent requests share the same pending read; success, no match, and failure cached for 60 seconds.
queryModel.scheduler: Two existing account-table reads per tick: refreshLineAccessTokens, then post-refresh snapshot. Default-token resolution and cache publication reuse the second snapshot and add zero queries. The PR's extra pre-refresh lookup is removed.
queryModel.writes: No new writes. Existing refresh writes only for active accounts whose expiry is unknown or within 7 days.
queryModel.readScope: SELECT * FROM line_accounts; linear in configured account rows, independent of friend/message/history counts. No new index or migration.

syntheticVerification.failure: Concurrent errors are shared and cached; one retry after TTL.
syntheticVerification.refreshRace: An older delayed or failing HTTP read cannot restore a pre-refresh snapshot.
syntheticVerification.accountIsolation: Separate DB bindings and default secrets cannot share cached tokens.

costLimits.realD1RowsRead: Unmeasured; test call counts are not billed rows.
costLimits.worstCasePerDay: For one stable DB/default-secret binding per isolate, steady HTTP cache misses start at most once each 60-second interval; scheduler continues its existing cadence. Isolate restarts add cold reads. Existing per-account refresh writes unchanged.

safety.explicitToken: Existing env token wins without helper queries or cache mutation.
safety.refreshFailure: Existing refresh error handling retained; still-valid token remains usable; no promise of recovery for already-expired credentials when issuance fails.
safety.rollback: Revert only this follow-up commit; schema/config unchanged. Do not deploy an old production bundle over unrelated production changes.
safety.productionOperations: None: no real sends, production SQL, secret changes or deployments.
